title: Breakdown. Heart.
html_source:
This is how Mr Cunningham has just described Paddy Dignam’s cause of death.

Is Bloom just mulling that over after being distracted by the window view?

Does he believe Charles Stewart Parnell also died of that cause? (It was actually pneumonia.)

Is it an expression of the depressing environment of this side of the street?

Or is this the thought he continually tries to suppress bubbling up again? Molly is breaking his heart.
